column1: # The closest answer a database holds where it cannot hold legend-pure's (PureDecimalArithmeticTest), measured: database, probe, answer.
# SQLite has no decimal type: a Decimal is its double, so a decimal half (1.005, 2.01 / 2) is the double below or above
# it, and a quotient past 15 digits keeps 15 (C5-J's batch, 2026-11-15; the register question posted with the batch)
# SQLite holds no NaN and no infinity: parseFloat('NaN') and either infinity read as 0.0 (measured, 2026-11-16)
